verdict.rationale: Docs show fast path to a live workspace (cloud signup 'in under a minute' or single-command Docker install) plus CSV/XLSX import with field mapping, duplicate detection, and error handling, and quick object/pipeline setup — all self-serve with no partner required. However, a hands-on community report calls the product 'pretty alpha' and describes hitting small issues that ultimately made it 'not quite work' for their use case, casting doubt on a smooth sub-hour real-data onboarding for every user. Missing for 10: independent time-boxed onboarding benchmark/case study confirming the under-an-hour claim end-to-end with real business data, and resolution of the alpha-stability concerns raised by users.
